//: Lint config for the QA AZM Digital Agent docs. Every rule below is disabled for a stated structural reason, not to paper over sloppiness — the mechanical rules (MD022/MD031/MD032/MD040) are all enforced and clean.
//MD041: first-line-heading. Agent and command files MUST open with a YAML frontmatter block (`---`) — that is the Claude Code harness contract, and the loader reads `name`/`description`/`tools` from it. Inserting an H1 above the frontmatter would break every agent in the framework, so this rule cannot apply to these documents.
//MD013: line-length. These are prompts, not prose for humans to wrap by hand — a sentence is one logical instruction to the model, and hard-wrapping it adds nothing and risks breaking inline code spans.
//MD033: no-inline-html. The report templates the orchestrator emits are HTML by design (figure/figcaption for embedded evidence), so inline HTML appears in the instructions that describe them.
//MD024: no-duplicate-heading. Per-stage sections legitimately repeat the same sub-heading (`Checklist:`, `Output`, `Return`) across agents and across stages within qa-validator.
